tools.name: codesys_status
tools.description: Read cached connection, project, queue, capabilities and codingStandards settings/rules/revision without CODESYS API calls. Read this first: enabled coding rules are enforced by MCP without Skills. Use context for engineering requests.

tools.name: codesys_project_query
tools.description: Query the current project structure, search, applications or I/O. Use summary=true or pageBytes (4096..262144) for fixed structure/search pages; continue with cursor. Read-only and queued.

tools.name: codesys_object_read
tools.description: Read objects in one native request. Follow nextCursor; pageBytes (4096..262144) bounds the complete MCP result. format=code delivers directly readable code chunks; sections selects a partial view without editing refs. Full objects/configuration receive readRef only after complete delivery. Old JSON/cursor calls remain supported.

tools.name: codesys_project_apply
tools.description: Submit one ordered feature as changes[] with one Watcher command. Existing objects require readRef; patches must match exactly once. Read codesys_status.codingStandards first: enabled rules require Chinese semantic comments near interfaces/state/critical nodes, type naming and 120-character lines; diagnostics identify section/line/repairHint. No Skill required. Trace config.display supports auto grouping or explicit diagrams with visible variable associations and Auto/Fixed axes. Put compileAfter/saveAfterCompile at batch root. Compile once after changes, save only when requested. Stops on failure, preserves prior effects, never replays unknown effects.

display.description: MCP configures native diagrams and axes. Auto groups by supplied unit/type hints or documented name heuristics; PLC symbol types are not resolved. Explicit groups cover each recording variable exactly once. Omit on update to preserve existing display and attach new unbound variables. Creation defaults to auto.

variables.description: Supply the complete desired ordered variable bindings. Add, remove, replace or reorder bindings; [] removes all variables. tools.name: codesys_project_compile
tools.description: Explicitly compile the current project once, without saving. Do not repeat a compile already performed by an apply batch.

tools.name: codesys_project_file
tools.description: Explicitly save, save_as, or create a new project from the product template matching the actual connected IDE version/profile. create and save_as require a new targetPath and never overwrite. create allows an empty IDE and requires the current project to be saved.

tools.name: codesys_request
tools.description: Observe the original queued/running/terminal request, with optional waitMs (0..20000, default 0), or cancel it only while queued. Engineering submissions also accept waitMs (default 1000). Waiting never replays the request; UNKNOWN only recovers the original result.

tools.name: codesys_library_query
tools.description: Read referenced or installed libraries, search or inspect an exact library identity. Use summary=true or pageBytes for installed/search pages and cursor to continue the fixed snapshot. Does not modify references or open a different project.
